desc:
*“They shall be my finest clerics, these girls who give themselves to me. Like clay I shall mould them and in the furnace of war forge them. They will be of iron will and elegant beauty. In great robes shall I clad them and with the mightiest bombs will they be armed. They will be untouched by plague or disease, no sickness will blight them. They will have tactics, strategies and yin-yang orbs such that no foe can best them in battle. They are my bulwark against the Yōkai. They are the Defenders of Humanity. They are my Shrine Maidens and they shall* ***know no fear.”***

—The Hakurei God-Emperor.
